prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

+import pytest
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models.models import CreditTransaction, Workspace
+from app.services.ai import ai_service
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def assert_billing(workspace_id, costs):
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        assert session.get(Workspace, workspace_id).credits == 500 + sum(costs)
+        assert session.exec(select(CreditTransaction.amount).where(CreditTransaction.workspace_id == workspace_id, CreditTransaction.amount < 0)).all() == costs
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("action,cost", [
+    ("cover", 15), ("sheet", 20), ("render", 12), ("style", 10), ("workflow_cover", 15),
+])
+def test_only_successful_generation_is_billed(client, monkeypatch, action, cost):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": "Night Bus"}).json()
+    workspace_id = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=headers).json()[0]["id"]
+    payload = {}
+    if action == "sheet":
+        character = client.post("/api/v1/characters", headers=headers, json={
+            "project_id": project["id"], "name": "Driver",
+        }).json()
+        path = f"/api/v1/characters/{character['id']}/generate"
+        method = "generate_character_sheet"
+    elif action == "style":
+        path = "/api/v1/styles"
+        payload = {"name": "Ink", "description": "Fine ink lines"}
+        method = "generate_image"
+    elif action == "workflow_cover":
+        path = f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}/art-style"
+        payload = {"art_style": "Ink"}
+        method = "generate_project_cover_image"
+    elif action == "cover":
+        path = f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}/cover"
+        method = "generate_project_cover_image"
+    else:
+        path = "/api/v1/scenes/render"
+        payload = {"project_id": project["id"], "prompt": "City skyline"}
+        method = "generate_image"
+
+    def fail(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise RuntimeError("Generation failed")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_service, method, fail)
+    response = client.post(path, headers=headers, json=payload)
+    assert response.status_code == (500 if action == "render" else 200), response.text
+    assert_billing(workspace_id, [])
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_service, method, lambda *args, **kwargs: b"generated image")
+    response = client.post(path, headers=headers, json=payload)
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    assert_billing(workspace_id, [-cost])
+
+
+def test_competing_jobs_cannot_spend_the_same_credits(client):
+    from app.core.errors import AppException, ErrorCode
+    from app.services.billing import billing_service
+
+    headers = signup(client)
+    workspace_id = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=headers).json()[0]["id"]
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        workspace = session.get(Workspace, workspace_id)
+        workspace.credits = 15
+        session.commit()
+        args = (session, workspace.id, workspace.owner_id, "generate_project_cover_image")
+        first = billing_service.prepare_charge(*args)
+        second = billing_service.prepare_charge(*args)
+        first.commit(session)
+        with pytest.raises(AppException) as error:
+            second.commit(session)
+        assert error.value.error_code == ErrorCode.PAYMENT_INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS
+        assert workspace.credits == 0
+        debits = session.exec(select(CreditTransaction.amount).where(
+            CreditTransaction.workspace_id == workspace.id,
+            CreditTransaction.amount < 0,
+        )).all()
+        assert debits == [-15]

+from datetime import datetime
+from uuid import UUID, uuid4
+
+from sqlmodel import Session
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models.models import CreditTransaction, WorkspaceMember
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def test_member_can_read_all_workspace_credit_changes(client):
+    owner = signup(client)
+    member = signup(client, "member@example.com")
+    workspace = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=owner).json()[0]
+    other = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=member).json()[0]
+    path = f"/api/v1/workspaces/{workspace['id']}/credits/history"
+    assert client.get(path, headers=owner).json() == []
+
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        session.add(WorkspaceMember(workspace_id=UUID(workspace["id"]), user_id=UUID(other["owner_id"])))
+        for ws, day, amount, action in [
+            (workspace, 2, 15, "refund"),
+            (other, 4, -20, "generate_character_sheet"),
+            (workspace, 3, 50, "daily_refill"),
+            (workspace, 1, -15, "generate_project_cover_image"),
+        ]:
+            session.add(CreditTransaction(
+                workspace_id=UUID(ws["id"]), user_id=UUID(ws["owner_id"]),
+                amount=amount, action_type=action, timestamp=datetime(2026, 1, day),
+            ))
+        session.commit()
+
+    response = client.get(path, headers=member)
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == [
+        {"amount": 50, "action": "daily_refill", "created_at": "2026-01-03T00:00:00"},
+        {"amount": 15, "action": "refund", "created_at": "2026-01-02T00:00:00"},
+        {"amount": -15, "action": "generate_project_cover_image", "created_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00"},
+    ]
+
+
+def test_history_hides_workspace_from_nonmembers(client):
+    owner = signup(client)
+    outsider = signup(client, "outsider@example.com")
+    workspace = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=owner).json()[0]
+    responses = [
+        client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{wid}/credits/history", headers=outsider)
+        for wid in (workspace["id"], uuid4())
+    ]
+    assert [response.status_code for response in responses] == [404, 404]
+    assert responses[0].json() == responses[1].json()
